_doc: E472 TRAILERS P15: the player cinematics' sound design. Stable Audio 3 Medium (MOSS v2 too when its memory gate allows), the better take by CLAP rank (sfx_pick.py). `desc` is the CLAP ranking text.

p15-gallop.desc: a horse galloping fast on grass, close
p15-gallop.prompt: A single horse galloping fast across open grassland, close to the microphone: heavy rhythmic hoofbeats, breath, tack jingling, wind. Cinematic sound effect, no music.

p15-splash.desc: a horse landing in shallow surf with a big splash
p15-splash.prompt: A galloping horse lands hard in shallow sea surf: a big heavy water splash and spray, then hooves splashing on through the shallows. Cinematic sound effect, no music.

p15-hit.desc: a huge deep cinematic trailer impact boom
p15-hit.prompt: One huge deep cinematic trailer impact: a massive low boom with a metallic crack and a long rumbling tail. Trailer sound design, no music.

p15-whoosh.prompt: A single fast cinematic whoosh rushing past the camera, clean cut-off. Trailer sound design, no music.

p15-steps.desc: several people walking in boots on asphalt
p15-steps.prompt: Four people walking slowly together in heavy boots on an asphalt road, armour and buckles clinking softly, a faint wind. No music, no voices.

p15-rumble.desc: a giant creature rising with a deep ground rumble and roar
p15-rumble.prompt: A colossal creature rising out of a forest: deep ground rumble, trees cracking, a low monstrous bellow building to a roar. Cinematic creature sound design, no music.

p15-blades.desc: several swords drawn from scabbards at once
p15-blades.prompt: Several metal swords drawn from their scabbards at the same moment: a sharp ringing shing of steel, close. Cinematic sound effect, no music.

p15-wind.desc: rushing wind of a skydiving freefall
p15-wind.prompt: The roaring rushing wind of a skydiver in freefall, cloth flapping hard, high altitude air. Cinematic sound effect, no music.

p15-dragon.desc: a huge dragon roar echoing through a city
p15-dragon.prompt: A huge dragon roars, a deep resonant roar echoing between tall buildings in the rain, with a rumbling growl tail. Cinematic creature sound design, no music.

p15-rain.desc: rain on rooftops in a city at night
p15-rain.prompt: Steady rain falling on tiled rooftops and neon signs in a city at night, water dripping, a distant hum. No music, no voices.
